user.title: UniFi Dream Router 7
user.description: Connects a UniFi Dream Router 7 and the UniFi devices adopted to it. Use a local UniFi OS account (not a UI account with two-factor login) with admin rights in UniFi Network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Dream Router.
data_description.username: Local UniFi OS account with admin rights in UniFi Network.
data_description.site: UniFi Network site, "default" unless you renamed it.
data_description.verify_ssl: Off by default: UniFi OS uses a self-signed certificate, so the integration remembers the certificate the router shows at setup and accepts only that one afterwards. Turn on only if the router has a certificate from a trusted authority.
